name: No Gap Between Slices
description: Validates that there is no gap between slices (SpacingBetweenSlices should equal SliceThickness), within a configurable tolerance.
implementation:
slice_thickness = value["SliceThickness"].iloc[0]
spacing = value["SpacingBetweenSlices"].iloc[0] if "SpacingBetweenSlices" in value.columns and not pd.isna(value["SpacingBetweenSlices"].iloc[0]) else slice_thickness
gap = spacing - slice_thickness
max_gap = params.get("max_gap_mm")
if max_gap is not None and gap > max_gap:
    raise ValidationWarning(f"Gap detected between slices ({gap:.1f} mm). SpacingBetweenSlices should equal SliceThickness.")

testCases.name: 1 mm gap passes with loose tolerance

parameterDefinitions.name: max_gap_mm
parameterDefinitions.label: Maximum gap
parameterDefinitions.description: Warn if the inter-slice gap exceeds this
